Checkout API has been slower than usual in Europe since 14:02 UTC. Requests that normally finish in a quarter of a second are taking up to two seconds, and a small share of them time out before they reach the payment provider. We have moved traffic away from the affected region while we find the cause, and most requests now complete as they should. If you saw an error during that window, retrying the request is safe: no payment was taken twice.
Every page in these docs is checked against the API it describes. When a field changes, the page that mentions it is marked as out of date within minutes, and the people who own it get a short note that names the field, the old shape and the new one. Readers see the same mark at the top of the page, with the date it was last verified, so nobody copies an example that no longer works. Most fixes are a single line, and the editor suggests it for you.
To send your first request, create a key in the dashboard and keep it somewhere safe, such as your secret store or an environment variable on the server. Keys are shown once. Requests from a browser should go through your own server, which adds the key, so it never reaches the page. If a key leaks, revoke it from the same screen and create a new one; old requests stop working at once, and nothing else about your account changes.
